primary_input: full 42 taxa × 18 complete Azami visual endpoints reconstructed from frozen 9612943217 + 9633419268, as JSON marked head-only
biological_question: Are the two observed head module signatures geographically or environmentally transportable or driven by one sampling stratum? Marginal covariance does not establish adaptive interaction.

splits.definition: West if taxon median longitude <0, East otherwise; not a taxon's native region and may cross introduced occurrences
below global taxon median versus at/above
below global taxon median versus at/above
below global taxon median versus at/above

estimands: Within-stratum signed Pearson correlations of 42 taxon-median visible traits; contrast r_high-r_low
Fisher r→atanh transform of differences, test via 9999 taxon-label reassignment permutations preserving original group membership count
Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted family across three pairs x four contrasts (12 exploratory interaction contrasts)
Within-group bootstrap 3000 taxon resamples for correlation uncertainty; no group-wise p-hacking
Reference pooled signs and signed region correlations
stop_rules: Do not infer evolutionary significance from a shuffled taxon label p without preserving phylogenetic relatedness
Do not call climatic median groups independently measured pollinator/seed predator regimes
Do not interpret camera pose or image silhouettes as true anatomical spine lengths or mechanical protection
Group split with <8 taxa or near-zero SD returns NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
If a split is significant, this is an exploratory context-dependent phenotype association, not observed compensatory selection or adaptation
If all splits null, do not conclude invariant coupling in other ecological regimes
claim_ceiling: Sample-bound descriptive cross-condition coupling sensitivity only, no functional trait x fitness, no random-evolution null.
